notes_for_editor: Thin record. The 100-foot height and 1950 build date both come from one personal essay in Our State, whose date is not visible in our copy; the essay is the author's family recollection. The state list and Forest Lookouts give coordinates and agency only, with no build date. A 2007 blog post places the tower at the crest. Search results also showed an undated Greensboro News & Record feature that calls the tower state-owned, but its article text in our cache is encoded, so it is not cited. Condition, staffing today and public access are unknown; a human should check with the NC Division of Forest Resources before anyone visits.
